name: ctui
description: A skin for the Claude Code TUI: a docked sidebar with git, context, limits, MCP, todo and agent sections, plus agent and shell toasts.

context_enable.title: Context section
context_enable.description: Show the context-window section in the sidebar

context_folded.title: Context folded
context_folded.description: Start each session with the Context section folded

limits_enable.title: Limits section
limits_enable.description: Show the usage-limits section in the sidebar

limits_folded.title: Limits folded
limits_folded.description: Start each session with the Limits section folded

limits_cost.title: Limits cost
limits_cost.description: Show this month's cost against your limit; auto hides it on a Claude plan

limits_cost_monthly.title: Limits monthly cost
limits_cost_monthly.description: Monthly cost limit in USD; 0 shows the total with no limit

todo_enable.title: Todo section
todo_enable.description: Show the todo list section in the sidebar

todo_folded.title: Todo folded
todo_folded.description: Start each session with the Todo section folded

todo_tools.title: Task tools
todo_tools.description: Give Claude the Task tools (TaskCreate, TaskList, TaskUpdate) on models without them by default, such as Opus 5.x, by setting CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1 for the session; the Todo section shows their list

skills_enable.title: Skills section
skills_enable.description: Show the skills this chat has used in the sidebar

skills_folded.title: Skills folded
skills_folded.description: Start each session with the Skills section folded

mcp_enable.title: MCP section
mcp_enable.description: Show the MCP servers section in the sidebar

mcp_folded.title: MCP folded
mcp_folded.description: Start each session with the MCP section folded

agents_enable.title: Agents & shells section
agents_enable.description: Show running subagents and background shells in the sidebar

agents_folded.title: Agents & shells folded
agents_folded.description: Start each session with the Agents & shells section folded

agents_toasts.title: Agent and shell toasts
agents_toasts.description: Show a toast when a subagent or background shell starts, finishes or fails

order.title: Sidebar order
order.description: Sidebar sections in order, as comma-separated ids: context, limits, todo, skills, mcp, agents. Unknown ids are ignored; missing ones follow in this order

theme.title: Sidebar theme
theme.description: Theme for the sidebar: inherit follows your Claude Code theme, or pick a ctui theme
